Subject: New vendor onboarding — PO credentials + line items

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday. We're ready to move forward with Redwood for inference capacity for our media personalization pipeline. Procurement asked me to follow up with the onboarding checklist and confirm the PO number and spend cap so we can complete their vendor setup.

Attached is our filled vendor onboarding form and the initial SKU breakdown we received from our engineering team. A few notes from procurement:
- They need a formal PO number that matches our purchase reference to complete the vendor record.
- Spend cap: we expect an initial monthly commitment of $75,000, but they want a PO-level cap noted.
- Line items: our finance team flagged two SKU lines that should be combined (tracking & embedding tokens).

Can you advise on the PO issuance process and whether Redwood can provide a provisional PO number while finance issues an approved contract? Also let us know if you need any additional fields on the onboarding form.

Attachments: [Calyx_Vendor_Form.pdf (PDF, 145KB)], [sku_breakdown.xlsx (Excel, 32KB)]

Best,
Alice Chen
Head of Procurement | CalyxMedia

Hi Alice,

Welcome — excited to have CalyxMedia moving to Redwood. We can absolutely provide a provisional PO reference to unblock your vendor record while legal/finance finalize contract signatures.

Suggested approach:
- Provisional PO: we can issue a provisional PO reference that your systems can use (formal PO will replace this once finance completes approvals).
- Spend cap: we'll annotate the provisional PO with an initial monthly spend cap of $75,000 per your request; please confirm if that should be monthly vs. quarterly.
- Line items: Jordan (procurement ops) — can you confirm the SKU merge for "tracking" + "embedding tokens" and whether the combined line should be labeled "Token Processing (combined)"? We'll produce an updated line-item mapping file for your ledger.

I'll kick this over to Jordan and Connor to issue the provisional PO and attach the mapping. Marissa, tagging you for invoice routing and PO acceptance workflows.

Mina
